hits.subject: riscv: Avoid enabling interrupts in die()
hits.reason: the fix stops spin_unlock_irq from re-enabling interrupts in die(); the flag claims a possible sleep through console_lock inside die_lock

hits.subject: riscv: Fix build with CONFIG_CC_OPTIMIZE_FOR_SIZE=y
hits.reason: the fix drops a static branch from cpu_relax that broke -Os builds; the flag is about the noinstr contract
